hero.title: Situational Awareness
hero.subtitle1: Monitor event impacts in real time
hero.subtitle2: Make informed decisions when they matter most

intro.title: Take quick action backed by data and analysis
intro.paragraph: In the complex realm of business operations or large-scale events, it's difficult to know what is happening where. Using location intelligence, business leaders and first responders see a holistic view of the situation—real-time data such as weather and traffic, on-the-ground updates, plus the locations of assets, crews, and other resources. This approach leads to smart decisions in the moment and predictive abilities for the future.

opportunities.title: See the big picture others can’t
opportunities.intro: Decision-makers gain clarity from location intelligence whether they need to react to supply chain disruptions, repair damage to a utility network, or coordinate first responders in an emergency.
bullets: Monitor resources and operations in real time.
Integrate data from multiple sources including Internet of Things (IoT) and social media feeds.
Visualize and share all key information with one map view.
Perform quick spatial analysis of an impending event.
Create an informed incident response plan in minutes.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Monitor operations, share data, and create actionable intelligence using location intelligence technology from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Real-Time Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Know where dangers exist right now across your community or business and monitor changing situations. Use big data and Internet of Things (IoT) technology to make quick, informed decisions based on the most up-to-date information.

items.title: 3D Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Create your vision and extract value from your raw data. See hidden relationships, patterns, and trends. Share your ideas with others.

items.title: Mapping
items.body: Visualize people, places, and assets to gain important insights into customers and competitors. See what's happening across a network of store locations, create strong business plans, and know where to allocate resources.

items.title: Real-Time Location Tracking
items.body: Gain insights from your data whether you are tracking moving assets or stationary sensors. Make the right decision at the right time.

items.title: Crisis Response
items.body: When an event occurs, quickly address the impacts, maintain operational awareness, conduct damage assessments, and inform stakeholders.

items.title: Safety and Security
items.body: Get a proactive view of emerging threats and hazards to respond more quickly and help save lives.

items.title: Managing a Marathon with Real-time Awareness
items.excerpt: Chicago used real-time awareness of the marathon course to help inform and guide public safety response and resources.

items.title: San Antonio Prepares for the NCAA Final Four
items.excerpt: San Antonio police used real-time GIS for situational awareness to ensure the safety of NCAA players, coaches, facility staff, and attendees.

items.title: Argentina Guards against Fish Poachers
items.excerpt: National security agency uses GIS and real-time tracking to aid anti-poaching efforts in Argentina by integrating sensors and satellite input.
